title: Derived evaluation of arbitrary left-module sheaves commutes with forgetting scalars
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site in the common coefficient universe [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-size-convention], let $\Lambda$ be any unital ring, and let $\Lambda_{\mathcal C}$ be its constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Use left-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $V:\operatorname{Mod}(\Lambda_{\mathcal C})\to\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ and $v:\Lambda\text{-}\operatorname{Mod}\to\operatorname{Ab}$ for forgetting scalars. For $W\in\mathcal C$ let $\Gamma_W(M)=M(W)$ with its constant $\Lambda$-action. Derived functors are computed by injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions]; assume the sheaf categories have enough injectives. For every $K\in D^+(\operatorname{Mod}(\Lambda_{\mathcal C}))$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories] there is a canonical natural isomorphism
$$vR\Gamma_W K\cong R\Gamma_W(VK)\quad\text{in }D^+(\operatorname{Ab}).$$
If $L^\bullet$ is any bounded-below complex of injective module sheaves with $QL\cong K$, then $VL^\bullet$ is termwise $\Gamma_W$-acyclic in abelian sheaves and $L^\bullet(W)$, after forgetting scalars, computes both sides. No injectivity of $VL^m$ is asserted. The comparison is induced by the identity of underived evaluation functors; it is natural in $W$ and $K$. For sites with terminal objects, the comparisons at the terminal objects commute with canonical global-cohomology pullback along geometric morphisms with constant coefficients, whose exact module inverse image is [lem-pe-constant-left-module-inverse-image]. For arrows of objects of one site they commute with the derived evaluation restriction maps. In particular it identifies the underlying abelian group of $H^n(R\Gamma_W K)$ with $H^n(R\Gamma_W(VK))$ for every integer $n$.

source.place: Tag 03FD, lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree and its injective-acyclicity proof, extended to bounded-below complexes by derived.tex Tag 05TA, proposition-enough-acyclics (1); canonical comparison induced by evaluation identity

proof.text: Forgetful V and v are exact. Abelian inverse-image exactness follows by reflecting limits through underlying sets and using its left-adjoint structure for colimits. The underived evaluation square is the literal identity.

The existing injective-module abelian acyclicity theorem, transported along the cohomology/right-derived sections isomorphism, proves forgottenInjectiveAcyclic. Apply the general right-acyclic base-change criterion for the comparison. For an injective complex use its invertible module unit and the acyclic-complex unit criterion on its image under V.

For restriction, right-derived uniqueness reduces the desired equality to the homotopy category. Expand the comparison factorization and the derived natural-transformation unit identity. Naturality of the exact forgetting comparison and the literal equality of forgotten restriction maps finish the equality.

Construct normalizedGlobalPullback explicitly: terminal-constant-sheaf maps represent sections. Preservation of products and abelian_addition prove additivity. Natural scalar endomorphisms and scalar_compatibility prove linearity, without assuming the ring commutative. Naturality gives the two section transformations and moduleSetIso_compatibility gives their forgotten square. Apply rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange_cube with identity output functors. The exact derived identity unit laws cancel the output comparisons, leaving the required derivedUnderlying and global pullback equation.
Apply homology to the comparison isomorphism and compose with the exact forgetting homology isomorphism in every integer degree.

Proved underlying injective evaluation-acyclicity from the existing ringed-site 03FD comparison, used the existing bounded-below acyclicity criterion for the canonical derived unit, and instantiated the general derived cube twice for restrictions and geometric pullback. No new nodes or claim of underlying injectivity.

tool_uses.why: Exactness of forgetting module sheaves on an arbitrary small ringed site; needed to form the exact derived lift, not a geometric comparison theorem.
Objectwise 03FD for a single sheaf gives vanishing of underlying abelian cohomology of injective module sheaves.
Generic enough-injectives theorem supplies bounded-below representatives.
Applied to the integer sheaf, supplies the Grothendieck hypothesis required by the existing complex acyclicity criterion.
Its complex clause computes evaluation on a bounded-below acyclic complex; the unit has no more specific replacement for this homological tool.
General exact-square cube compatibility lifts the evaluation restriction and inverse-image unit squares; no geometric route step is replaced.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q145-21cb3010a (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the whole item and every cited node statement. I checked Stacks 03FD (sites-cohomology.tex l.1862, no commutativity used) and 015E (derived.tex l.5717); tags 05TA and 0736 are present. Step 1: forgetful(1) gives V exact; v exact and vG_W=G_{0,W}V are elementary. Step 2: the ringed-site 03FD comparison node (I checked its proof, nothing commutative) plus the one-term injective resolution give H^q(W,VJ)=0, so VJ is acyclic and nowhere claimed injective. Step 3: the dplus representative, Grothendieck at Z_C and leray-acyclicity(3) applied to id_VL give the iso unit; bounded-below injectives are K-injective, so the conventions agree. Step 4: the cube lemma's fac property identifies R(a) with a_W; with P=Q=id, U=U'=V, a..d=id and e,e0 the restrictions, it yields naturality in W. Step 5: the cube with f^*_Λ, f^{-1} and d from lem-pe-constant-left-module-inverse-image; the unit agreement is the underived hypothesis and no claim that P preserves injectives is used. Step 6 is elementary. Small cases: zero ring; point site with F_p (forgotten injective is not injective in Ab but is evaluation-acyclic); M_2(F_p); negative degrees. The étale/commutative nodes etale-module-cohomology-forget, derived-module-underlying-comparison and sbc-injective-module-forget-evaluation-acyclic are special cases, not duplicates. There are no new nodes. I accept the six declared generic tool_uses. Minor, no change: the sheafification-existence hypothesis in step 1 is justified in words with no node cited, as in the reviewed comparison node. The unit binding mismatch for sk-prop-sf-comparison was already there and is left for maintenance.
